tagline: Surface Jira issue updates in Discord engineering channels automatically
metaTitle: Jira Software Cloud Discord Integration: Issue Alerts
metaDescription: Post Jira status changes and critical bugs to the right Discord channels, and create issues from messages. See how GAIA sets it up.
intro:
Engineering teams that collaborate on Discord still rely on Jira for issue tracking, but context gets siloed between the two. Developers miss status changes because they're heads-down in chat, while issue comments go unnoticed by contributors who don't have notifications configured.

GAIA bridges Discord and Jira so engineers stay informed in their primary channel. Issue transitions, new assignments, and sprint updates post to the right channels automatically, and team members can create issues directly from chat without switching tools.

useCases.title: Post Jira issue status changes to Discord
useCases.description: When an issue transitions, from 'In Progress' to 'In Review', for example, GAIA posts an update to the linked channel. Engineers see real-time sprint progress without checking Jira constantly.

useCases.title: Create Jira issues from Discord messages
useCases.description: A slash command or emoji reaction lets contributors file an issue without leaving chat. GAIA pre-fills the summary, description, and project from the message context.

useCases.title: Alert the engineering channel when a bug is set to Critical
useCases.description: GAIA monitors for priority escalations and posts an immediate alert to your engineering channel when a ticket is marked Critical or Blocker. The right engineers are notified without delay.

useCases.title: Daily sprint digest in the standup channel
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA posts a summary of open sprint issues, blockers, and items completed yesterday to your standup channel. Teams get sprint visibility without a dedicated standup meeting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your server and your issue-tracking project. Map channels to projects so updates and alerts land in the right place.
Select which events, status changes, priority escalations, new assignments, trigger channel posts. Define which channels can create issues.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps channels and issues synchronized
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and routes information according to your rules. Engineers stay informed in chat while Jira remains the authoritative issue tracker.

faqs.question: Do contributors need a Jira account to create issues from Discord?
faqs.answer: Creating issues via GAIA requires the GAIA account to have write access to the project. Contributors trigger creation from chat, but the issue is filed under GAIA's connected identity.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify different channels for different projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map each project to a separate channel in GAIA's settings. Issues from the mobile project post to the mobile channel, backend issues to the backend channel, and so on.

faqs.question: Will GAIA spam the server with every minor comment?
faqs.answer: No. You control which event types trigger notifications. By default, GAIA only posts status transitions and priority changes — not every comment — to keep signal high.
